name: Andrew B. Cash
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
about: For more than two decades, attorney Andy Cash has provided skilled legal representation to individuals and families impacted by the most devastating tragedies. He has been named to the Top 100 Attorneys List by Thomson Reuters Super Lawyers six times and is listed in Best Lawyers in America for his work on behalf of clients.

Andy earned his Juris Doctor from Emory University School of Law and Bachelor of Arts from Vanderbilt University. He is an active member of the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, State Bar of Georgia and American Association for Justice. Given the level of his success in the courtroom, Andy is regularly asked and routinely speaks at legal seminars on various trial issues, techniques and strategies.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
